messages.subject: Project Cedar - SPA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (tracked). Headline points: we've set the general warranty cap at 50% of consideration; lifted the de minimis to £35,000; and extended the general warranty notification period to 24 months. We can discuss but the cap is important to our clients - a nominal cap on the seller-backed warranties isn't acceptable.

Jonathan
Castle & Vane LLP
